Theorem 1 provides asymptotic convergence guarantees that support the application of ϵ-RANDUP
in general scenarios (e.g., as a baseline for ofﬂine validation in complex problem settings), but does
not provide ﬁnite-sample guarantees which are of practical interest in safety-critical applications.
